extraction.name: Geometry3K
extraction.description: Geometry3K is a large-scale benchmark dataset consisting of 3,002 multi-choice high-school geometry problems with dense annotations in formal language. Each problem includes problem text, a geometry diagram, four candidate choices, a correct answer, and formal language descriptions for both text and diagram.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Ran Gong, Shibiao Jiang, Liang Qiu, Siyuan Huang, Xiaodan Liang, Song-Chun Zhu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Problems were collected from two popular high-school textbooks (grades 6-12) via two online digital libraries (McGraw-Hill and Geometryonline). Groups of well-trained annotators with undergraduate degrees manually collected each problem with its problem text, geometry diagram, four candidate choices, and correct answer.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Two popular high-school textbooks (grades 6-12) sourced from two online digital libraries: McGraw-Hill and Geometryonline.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset is divided into train, validation, and test sets with the ratio of 0.7:0.1:0.2. Each problem is labeled with the corresponding problem goal and geometry shapes.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Well-trained annotators with undergraduate degrees manually collected each problem with its problem text, geometry diagram, four candidate choices, and correct answer. Each problem was further annotated with dense formal language descriptions for both text and diagram, including predicates and literals. Problem goal and geometry shapes were also labeled.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: For human performance evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk, each eligible annotator must have obtained a high school or higher degree, answer 10 problems in 25 minutes, spend at least 7 minutes on the problem set and 10 seconds on each problem. Annotators who did not satisfy the requirement were filtered out.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Annotators for data collection had undergraduate degrees. Human performance evaluators on Amazon Mechanical Turk were required to have a high school or higher degree. Human experts were graduates majoring in science or engineering.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Hough Transformation for geometry primitive extraction; RetinaNet for diagram symbol and text region detection; MathPix for optical character recognition.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work may inspire research in symbolic reasoning and interpretable models and facilitate education.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Inter-GPS might not find a solution because of inaccurate parsing results and the incomplete theorem set. Diagram parsing tends to fail if there are ambiguous annotations or multiple primitives in the diagram. The text parser has difficulty handling nested expressions and uncertain references. The symbolic solver is not capable of solving complex problems with combined shapes and shaded areas.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, validation, and testing of geometry problem solving algorithms; benchmarking symbolic reasoning and interpretable problem solving approaches; facilitating education research.
